question: Audit the same frozen GS_monthly as V12, establish earliest point-in-time proxy replay, compare all consecutive calendar blocks, and distinguish exposure, timing, and tail concentration.
earliest_rule: At least 63 finite preceding all-six returns excluding non-one-day marks; first observable mapped macro state with monthly credit and three PMI series; V12 comparator warm and finite. If a dated input cannot be verified, begin with the next supported date. Pre-listing history remains economic proxy evidence. All observable dates are in Asia/Shanghai.
rules: No changes to stage map, the two-or-three ETF subset, covariance lookback, benchmark, or order sizing. Main uses 9 bp one-way slippage; stress at 20 bp; broker fee from the prior frozen engine. Identical day ranges.
attribution: Exact additive daily log P&L by holding and expense
Amounts on and before ETF availability separated
Constant-weight mean exposure plus weight/return covariance
Matched removal of highest strategy days/months and highest relative years/months; zero return for both on identical dates
Cash replacement for each individual ETF and two largest contributors; no redistribution
negative_controls: Same five distinct portfolios with 1 and 3 month lag
Five rotations of the five distinct portfolio assignments including identity, no optimization
uncertainty: Paired calendar-year and contiguous phase observations; report sensitivity and dependence, no independently calibrated future outperformance probability.
actual: Rerun 2025-11-06 start for actual ETF validation, never mix actual shares and proxy returns in the same account.
decision: Compare CAGR, annualized volatility, maximum drawdown and Calmar; require stability and audit clearance before advancing beyond research.
